coverage.member: FusionTab(#if NET48 this HtmlHelper<TModel> html, #else this IHtmlHelper<TModel> html, #endif ReactivePlan<TModel> plan, string elementId, Action<TabBuilder> build)
coverage.catches: the FusionTab render helper stops rendering the tab bound to its sections (the test asserts the workspace opens on the Care Schedule header with that section's content — 'Today's care schedule' — visible)
the Selected event stops firing the reactive handler when the coordinator clicks a tab header, so opening Medications never updates the active-section line or shows the medications content
the .Reactive wiring stops connecting the tab's selected event to its plan pipeline, so clicking the Medications header runs no reaction and the workspace stays on Care Schedule
the selected-event arg contract stops delivering the payload into the plan, so the SelectedIndex branch cannot route and the active-section line never changes to Medications
SelectedIndex stops carrying the newly selected tab index (the test clicks the Medications header at index 1 and asserts the active-section line reads Medications and the medications content shows)
PreviousIndex stops carrying the index of the section just left (the test opens Medications then Incident Reports and asserts the context line reads 'You moved here from Medications.')
IsSwiped stops distinguishing a click (false) from a swipe (true); the test clicks a header and asserts the navigation line reads 'opened by selection.', which the swipe branch would never produce
